title: showcase: the showcase_account extension renames the object without a pluralLabel, so its list title loses Accounts / 客户 once PR #30459 lands
body:
domain:server#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CYVV6fcAQrNTDQRvPb

Filing gate: should-fix 1 of the contract review of PR #30459 (#30391), record 6658126879. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested grade: p3. ⛔ Serial after PR #30459 merges, which still needs the maintainer's word because it is BREAKING.

## What happens

`examples/app-showcase/src/data/extensions/account.extension.ts` renames `showcase_account` by setting `label` and no `pluralLabel`. With PR #30459, an extension that renames an object with no plural serves no stale base plural. That means the showcase's list title falls back to the singular label in both en and zh-CN.

## Ask

- Add `pluralLabel` to that extension.
- Add the pair translation in `examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/**` if the zh-CN plural is wanted.
- Pin it where the showcase's labels are already pinned.

Reader: `examples/app-showcase`. Links: #30391, PR #30459.
